state_gripper_units: SDK closure scale, continuous, retain feedback excursions

time.basis: HDF5 head image MCAP log_time; record-time proxy, not exposure/execution time
time.grid: time[0] + k/30 through time[-1], inclusive within numerical tolerance
time.observation_row: latest source row with time <= grid time
time.action_row: latest source row with time <= target grid time; use that row command, not measured state
time.tail: exclude anchors without all 7 valid future targets; no endpoint repetition/padding
time.invalid_window: exclude any window spanning a gap/invalid row; retain source indices and reason
time.command_timestamp_role: QC only; not each component timestamp
time.qc_threshold_status: chosen engineering gates, not verified sensor latency bounds
time.calculation: relative time = time-time[0]; compare to k/30
time.single_step_storage: action[k] = command selected for grid[k+1]; omit last grid row without next target
time.training_window: action[k:k+7], no additional one-step shift; require all seven valid

state_normalization: train split only; continuous all 10 dimensions; minimum std 1e-6 in native units
action_normalization: train split mean/std for arm/head only; minimum std 1e-6 rad; constant head targets normalize to zero
limitations: Original reviewed episodes lack matching raw per-component timestamp provenance.
HDF5 internal nearest matching can include messages after head record time.
Online delay and physical exposure/execution timing require separate validation.
